entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand Pulse you sold me is a complete piece of garbage. I want my money back, and I want it now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your device. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a fault! It's supposed to be a heart rate monitor, but the readings are a joke. It's completely inaccurate. Look, I don't have time for a million questions. I just want my money back.

I certainly understand your frustration. An inaccurate reading would defeat the purpose. We can sometimes resolve that with a quick calibration. Would you have a moment to try one or two troubleshooting steps with me?

No! I'm not doing your job for you! I paid for a working product, not a project. This thing is garbage and I want a refund. Are you going to process my refund or do I need to speak to a manager and light you up on every review site I can find?

That won't be necessary, I can absolutely handle this for you. Let me just pull up your account and review our policies. One moment... Ah, I see you're a VIP member with us. We really appreciate your business.

Okay, I've just checked our system. Our return policy allows for returns on any item within 90 days of delivery. I can see you received your VeloBand 32 days ago, so you are well within that timeframe.

I've gone ahead and processed a full refund for you. I'm also sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email we have on file. For the inconvenience, and as a thank you for being a loyal customer, I've also added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account.
Oh. A full refund and a fifty dollar credit? Okay. Well, that's better. I appreciate you handling that without giving me a hard time.
Of course. We want to make sure you're taken care of. That email with the label should be arriving shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
